import collections
import math

int parse_integer(string text)
    return int(text)

int floor_div(int numerator, int denominator)
    return if numerator >= 0 then numerator / denominator else -((-numerator + denominator - 1) / denominator)

int modulo(int value, int modulus)
    return value - modulus * floor_div(value, modulus)

string[] calendar_names()
    return "GREGORIAN JULIAN ISO ISLAMIC HEBREW PERSIAN COPTIC ETHIOPIC FRENCH MAYAN JD FIXED".split(" ")

string[] weekday_names()
    return "Sunday Monday Tuesday Wednesday Thursday Friday Saturday".split(" ")

string[] tzolkin_names()
    return "Imix Ik Akbal Kan Chicchan Cimi Manik Lamat Muluc Oc Chuen Eb Ben Ix Men Cib Caban Etznab Cauac Ahau".split(" ")

string[] haab_names()
    return "Pop Uo Zip Zotz Tzec Xul Yaxkin Mol Chen Yax Zac Ceh Mac Kankin Muan Pax Kayab Cumku Uayeb".split(" ")

int name_index(const string[] names, string name)
    for: 0 <= index < int(#names)
        if names[index] == name
            return index
    return -1

bool supported(int fixed)
    return 1 <= fixed <= 3652059

bool ymd_calendar(int calendar)
    return 0 <= calendar < 9 and calendar != 2

string weekday(int fixed)
    names := weekday_names()
    return names[modulo(fixed, 7)]

bool digits(string text, int maximum)
    if #text == 0 or int(#text) > maximum
        return false
    for code := text.codepoints()[]
        if code < 48 or code > 57
            return false
    return true

bool signed_digits(string text, int maximum)
    return digits(if text.starts_with("-") then text[1:] else text, maximum)

bool hebrew_leap(int year)
    return modulo(7 * year + 1, 19) < 7

int months_before(int calendar, int year)
    if calendar == 4
        return floor_div(235 * year - 234, 19)
    return (if calendar == 6 or calendar == 7 or calendar == 8 then 13 else 12) * (year - 1)

class Molad(int day_index, int parts, int fixed, string[] rules)

Molad molad_info(int year)
    quantity := 5604 + 765433 * months_before(4, year)
    day := floor_div(quantity, 25920)
    parts := modulo(quantity, 25920)
    postponed := day
    day_of_week := modulo(day - 1373427, 7)
    string[] rules := []
    if parts >= 19440
        postponed += 1
        rules = ["ZAKEN"]
    elif not hebrew_leap(year) and day_of_week == 2 and parts >= 9924
        postponed += 2
        rules = ["GATARAD"]
    elif hebrew_leap(year - 1) and day_of_week == 1 and parts >= 16789
        postponed += 1
        rules = ["BETUTAKPAT"]
    postponed_weekday := modulo(postponed - 1373427, 7)
    if postponed_weekday == 0 or postponed_weekday == 3 or postponed_weekday == 5
        postponed += 1
        rules = rules.append("ADU")
    return Molad(day, parts, postponed - 1373427, rules)

int year_start(int calendar, int year)
    previous := year - 1
    if calendar == 0
        return 365 * previous + floor_div(previous, 4) - floor_div(previous, 100) + floor_div(previous, 400) + 1
    if calendar == 1
        return 365 * previous + floor_div(previous, 4) - 1
    if calendar == 2
        january_fourth := year_start(0, year) + 3
        return january_fourth - modulo(january_fourth - 1, 7)
    if calendar == 3
        return 227015 + 354 * previous + floor_div(3 + 11 * year, 30)
    if calendar == 4
        return molad_info(year).fixed
    if calendar == 5
        offset := year - 474
        cyclic := modulo(offset, 2820) + 474
        return 226896 + 1029983 * floor_div(offset, 2820) + 365 * (cyclic - 1) + floor_div(682 * cyclic - 110, 2816)
    if calendar == 6 or calendar == 7
        return (if calendar == 6 then 103605 else 2796) + 365 * previous + floor_div(year, 4)
    return 654415 + 365 * previous + floor_div(previous, 4) - floor_div(previous, 100) + floor_div(previous, 400) - floor_div(previous, 4000)

int year_length(int calendar, int year)
    return year_start(calendar, year + 1) - year_start(calendar, year)

bool leap_year(int calendar, int year)
    if calendar == 0
        return modulo(year, 4) == 0 and (modulo(year, 100) != 0 or modulo(year, 400) == 0)
    if calendar == 1
        return modulo(year, 4) == 0
    if calendar == 2
        return year_length(calendar, year) == 371
    if calendar == 3
        leap_positions := [2, 5, 7, 10, 13, 16, 18, 21, 24, 26, 29]
        for position := leap_positions[]
            if modulo(year, 30) == position
                return true
        return false
    if calendar == 4
        return hebrew_leap(year)
    if calendar == 5
        cyclic := modulo(year - 474, 2820) + 474
        return modulo((cyclic + 38) * 682, 2816) < 682
    if calendar == 6 or calendar == 7
        return modulo(year, 4) == 3
    century := modulo(year, 400)
    return modulo(year, 4) == 0 and century != 100 and century != 200 and century != 300 and modulo(year, 4000) != 0

string hebrew_year_type(int year)
    length := year_length(4, year)
    return if length == 353 or length == 383 then "DEFICIENT" elif length == 355 or length == 385 then "COMPLETE" else "REGULAR"

int[] month_lengths(int calendar, int year)
    extra := if leap_year(calendar, year) then 1 else 0
    if calendar == 0 or calendar == 1
        return [31, 28 + extra, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31]
    if calendar == 3
        return [30, 29, 30, 29, 30, 29, 30, 29, 30, 29, 30, 29 + extra]
    if calendar == 4
        kind := hebrew_year_type(year)
        heshvan := if kind == "COMPLETE" then 30 else 29
        kislev := if kind == "DEFICIENT" then 29 else 30
        if extra == 1
            return [30, heshvan, kislev, 29, 30, 30, 29, 30, 29, 30, 29, 30, 29]
        return [30, heshvan, kislev, 29, 30, 29, 30, 29, 30, 29, 30, 29]
    if calendar == 5
        return [31, 31, 31, 31, 31, 31, 30, 30, 30, 30, 30, 29 + extra]
    lengths := array(12, fill = 30)
    return lengths.append(5 + extra)

string[] month_names(int calendar, int year)
    if calendar == 0 or calendar == 1
        return "January February March April May June July August September October November December".split(" ")
    if calendar == 3
        return "Muharram Safar RabiI RabiII JumadaI JumadaII Rajab Shaban Ramadan Shawwal DhuAlQidah DhuAlHijjah".split(" ")
    if calendar == 4
        if hebrew_leap(year)
            return "Tishri Heshvan Kislev Tevet Shevat AdarI AdarII Nisan Iyyar Sivan Tammuz Av Elul".split(" ")
        return "Tishri Heshvan Kislev Tevet Shevat Adar Nisan Iyyar Sivan Tammuz Av Elul".split(" ")
    if calendar == 5
        return "Farvardin Ordibehesht Khordad Tir Mordad Shahrivar Mehr Aban Azar Dey Bahman Esfand".split(" ")
    if calendar == 6
        return "Thout Paopi Hathor Koiak Tobi Meshir Paremhat Parmouti Pashons Paoni Epip Mesori Nasie".split(" ")
    if calendar == 7
        return "Meskerem Tekemt Hedar Tahsas Ter Yekatit Megabit Miazia Genbot Sene Hamle Nehase Pagume".split(" ")
    return "Vendemiaire Brumaire Frimaire Nivose Pluviose Ventose Germinal Floreal Prairial Messidor Thermidor Fructidor Sansculottides".split(" ")

int named_month(int calendar, int year, string name)
    names := month_names(calendar, year)
    found := name_index(names, name)
    if found < 0 and calendar == 4
        found = name_index(names, if name == "Adar" then "AdarII" else "Adar")
    return found + 1

int year_at(int calendar, int fixed)
    if fixed < year_start(calendar, 1)
        return 0
    low := 1
    high := 100000
    while high - low > 1
        middle := (low + high) / 2
        if year_start(calendar, middle) <= fixed
            low = middle
        else
            high = middle
    return low

class Date(int year, int month, int day)

Date from_fixed(int calendar, int fixed)
    year := year_at(calendar, fixed)
    if year == 0
        return Date(0, 0, 0)
    offset := fixed - year_start(calendar, year)
    if calendar == 2
        return Date(year, offset / 7 + 1, offset % 7 + 1)
    lengths := month_lengths(calendar, year)
    month := 1
    while offset >= lengths[month - 1]
        offset -= lengths[month - 1]
        month += 1
    return Date(year, month, offset + 1)

int to_fixed(int calendar, const Date date)
    int offset
    if calendar == 2
        offset = 7 * (date.month - 1)
    else
        lengths := month_lengths(calendar, date.year)
        offset = lengths[0:<date.month - 1].sum()
    return year_start(calendar, date.year) + offset + date.day - 1

string date_format(int calendar, int fixed)
    if not supported(fixed)
        return "OUT OF RANGE"
    if calendar < 9
        date := from_fixed(calendar, fixed)
        if date.year == 0
            return "OUT OF RANGE"
        if calendar == 2
            return "{date.year:04.}-W{date.month:02.}-{date.day}"
        return "{date.year:04.}-{date.month:02.}-{date.day:02.}"
    if calendar == 9
        count := fixed + 1137142
        haab := modulo(count + 348, 365)
        tz := tzolkin_names()
        hb := haab_names()
        return "{count / 144000}.{count / 7200 % 20}.{count / 360 % 20}.{count / 20 % 18}.{count % 20} {modulo(count + 3, 13) + 1} {tz[modulo(count + 19, 20)]} {haab % 20} {hb[haab / 20]}"
    return string(if calendar == 10 then fixed + 1721425 else fixed)

class Validation(string reason, fixed := 0)

Validation validate_date(int calendar, string text)
    int fixed
    if calendar < 9
        fields := text.split("-")
        if #fields != 3
            return Validation("FORMAT")
        if not digits(fields[0], 5)
            return Validation("FORMAT")
        month := fields[1]
        if calendar == 2
            if not month.starts_with("W") or not digits(month[1:], 2) or not digits(fields[2], 1)
                return Validation("FORMAT")
            month = month[1:]
        elif not digits(month, 2) or not digits(fields[2], 2)
            return Validation("FORMAT")
        date := Date(parse_integer(fields[0]), parse_integer(month), parse_integer(fields[2]))
        if date.year == 0
            return Validation("YEAR")
        if calendar == 2
            if date.month < 1 or date.month > year_length(calendar, date.year) / 7
                return Validation("WEEK")
            if date.day < 1 or date.day > 7
                return Validation("DAY")
        else
            lengths := month_lengths(calendar, date.year)
            if date.month < 1 or date.month > int(#lengths)
                return Validation("MONTH")
            if date.day < 1 or date.day > lengths[date.month - 1]
                return Validation("DAY")
        fixed = to_fixed(calendar, date)
    elif calendar == 9
        fields := text.split(".")
        if #fields != 5
            return Validation("FORMAT")
        for field := fields[]
            if not digits(field, 2)
                return Validation("FORMAT")
        values := [for field := fields[] then parse_integer(field)]
        if values[1] > 19 or values[2] > 19 or values[3] > 17 or values[4] > 19
            return Validation("FIELD")
        fixed = (((values[0] * 20 + values[1]) * 20 + values[2]) * 18 + values[3]) * 20 + values[4] - 1137142
    else
        if not signed_digits(text, 8)
            return Validation("FORMAT")
        fixed = parse_integer(text) - (if calendar == 10 then 1721425 else 0)
    return Validation(if supported(fixed) then "" else "RANGE", fixed)

Date | error shift_date(int calendar, const Date date, int years, int months)
    year := date.year + years
    if calendar == 2
        if year < 1 or year > 99999
            return error("OUT OF RANGE")
        return Date(year, math.min(date.month, year_length(calendar, year) / 7), date.day)
    month := date.month
    if calendar == 4
        names := month_names(calendar, date.year)
        month = named_month(calendar, year, names[date.month - 1])
    absolute := months_before(calendar, year) + month - 1 + months
    year = if calendar == 4 then floor_div(19 * absolute + 252, 235) else floor_div(absolute, if calendar == 6 or calendar == 7 or calendar == 8 then 13 else 12) + 1
    if year < 1 or year > 99999
        return error("OUT OF RANGE")
    month = absolute - months_before(calendar, year) + 1
    lengths := month_lengths(calendar, year)
    return Date(year, month, math.min(date.day, lengths[month - 1]))

class Computus(int golden, int epact, string letters, int moon, int easter)

Computus easter_info(int year, int calendar)
    golden := modulo(year, 19)
    epact := modulo(14 + 11 * golden, 30)
    if calendar == 0
        century := floor_div(year, 100) + 1
        epact = modulo(14 + 11 * golden - floor_div(3 * century, 4) + floor_div(5 + 8 * century, 25), 30)
        if epact == 0 or (epact == 1 and golden > 10)
            epact += 1
    moon := to_fixed(calendar, Date(year, 4, 19)) - epact
    letter := modulo(-year_start(calendar, year), 7)
    alphabet := "ABCDEFG"
    letters := alphabet[letter]
    if leap_year(calendar, year)
        letters += alphabet[modulo(letter - 1, 7)]
    return Computus(golden + 1, epact, letters, moon, moon + 7 - modulo(moon, 7))

string[] command_schema(string name)
    if name == "CONVERT"
        return "ANY DATE TO ANY".split(" ")
    if name == "ALL" or name == "VALID" or name == "WEEKDAY"
        return "ANY DATE".split(" ")
    if name == "INFO"
        return "YMD DATE".split(" ")
    if name == "LEAP" or name == "NEWYEAR"
        return "YEARCAL YEAR".split(" ")
    if name == "MONTHS"
        return "YMD YEAR".split(" ")
    if name == "MONTHCAL"
        return "YMD YEAR MONTH".split(" ")
    if name == "NTH"
        return "YMD YEAR MONTH OCCURRENCE WEEKDAY".split(" ")
    if name == "DIFF"
        return "ANY DATE ANY DATE".split(" ")
    if name == "COUNT"
        return "ANY DATE DATE WEEKDAY".split(" ")
    if name == "ADD"
        return "ANY DATE INTEGER UNIT".split(" ")
    if name == "SPAN"
        return "YMD DATE DATE".split(" ")
    if name == "EASTER" or name == "COMPUTUS"
        return "YEAR EASTER".split(" ")
    if name == "PASSOVER" or name == "HOLIDAYS" or name == "MOLAD"
        return ["YEAR"]
    if name == "ROUND"
        return "ANY DATE TZNUMBER TZNAME HAABDAY HAABMONTH".split(" ")
    return []

bool valid_arguments(string verb, const string[] arguments, const string[] schema)
    if #schema == 0 or #arguments != #schema
        return false
    for: 0 <= index < int(#schema)
        kind := schema[index]
        token := arguments[index]
        if kind == "ANY" or kind == "YEARCAL" or kind == "YMD"
            calendar := name_index(calendar_names(), token)
            if calendar < 0 or (kind == "YEARCAL" and calendar >= 9) or (kind == "YMD" and not ymd_calendar(calendar))
                return false
        elif kind == "YEAR"
            if not digits(token, 5) or parse_integer(token) == 0
                return false
        elif kind == "MONTH" or kind == "HAABDAY"
            if not digits(token, 2)
                return false
        elif kind == "INTEGER"
            if not signed_digits(token, 7)
                return false
        elif kind == "TO"
            if token != "TO"
                return false
        elif kind == "OCCURRENCE"
            if name_index(["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "LAST"], token) < 0
                return false
        elif kind == "WEEKDAY"
            if name_index(weekday_names(), token) < 0
                return false
        elif kind == "UNIT"
            if name_index(["DAYS", "WEEKS", "MONTHS", "YEARS"], token) < 0
                return false
        elif kind == "EASTER"
            if token != "GREGORIAN" and token != "JULIAN"
                return false
        elif kind == "TZNUMBER"
            if not digits(token, 2) or parse_integer(token) < 1 or parse_integer(token) > 13
                return false
        elif kind == "TZNAME"
            if name_index(tzolkin_names(), token) < 0
                return false
        elif kind == "HAABMONTH"
            if name_index(haab_names(), token) < 0
                return false
    if verb == "ADD"
        calendar := name_index(calendar_names(), arguments[0])
        if arguments[3] == "MONTHS" and not ymd_calendar(calendar)
            return false
        if arguments[3] == "YEARS" and calendar >= 9
            return false
    if verb == "ROUND" and parse_integer(arguments[4]) > (if arguments[5] == "Uayeb" then 4 else 19)
        return false
    return true

string trim_right(string text)
    while text.ends_with(" ")
        text = text[0:<int(#text) - 1]
    return text

string[] month_calendar(int calendar, int year, int month, int first, int last)
    names := month_names(calendar, year)
    result := ["{names[month - 1]} {year} ({date_format(0, first)} to {date_format(0, last)})", "Mo Tu We Th Fr Sa Su"]
    fields := array(7, fill = "  ")
    column := modulo(first - 1, 7)
    for: 1 <= day <= last - first + 1
        fields[column] = "{day:2.}"
        if column == 6 or day == last - first + 1
            result = result.append(trim_right(fields.join(" ")))
            fields = array(7, fill = "  ")
        column = (column + 1) % 7
    return result

class Holiday(int fixed, string name, int calendar)

string[] holiday_lines(int year)
    first := year_start(0, year)
    last := year_start(0, year + 1)
    easter := easter_info(year, 0).easter
    events := [Holiday(easter - 46, "AshWednesday", 0), Holiday(easter - 2, "GoodFriday", 0), Holiday(easter, "Easter", 0), Holiday(easter + 39, "Ascension", 0), Holiday(easter + 49, "Pentecost", 0), Holiday(easter_info(year, 1).easter, "OrthodoxEaster", 1)]
    definitions := [
        "Christmas GREGORIAN December 25",
        "OrthodoxChristmas JULIAN December 25",
        "RoshHashanah HEBREW Tishri 1",
        "YomKippur HEBREW Tishri 10",
        "Sukkot HEBREW Tishri 15",
        "Hanukkah HEBREW Kislev 25",
        "Purim HEBREW Adar 14",
        "Passover HEBREW Nisan 15",
        "Shavuot HEBREW Sivan 6",
        "IslamicNewYear ISLAMIC Muharram 1",
        "Ashura ISLAMIC Muharram 10",
        "Mawlid ISLAMIC RabiI 12",
        "RamadanStart ISLAMIC Ramadan 1",
        "EidAlFitr ISLAMIC Shawwal 1",
        "EidAlAdha ISLAMIC DhuAlHijjah 10",
        "Nowruz PERSIAN Farvardin 1",
        "SizdahBedar PERSIAN Farvardin 13",
        "Yalda PERSIAN Azar 30",
        "Nayrouz COPTIC Thout 1",
        "CopticChristmas COPTIC Koiak 29",
        "Enkutatash ETHIOPIC Meskerem 1",
        "Meskel ETHIOPIC Meskerem 17",
        "Timkat ETHIOPIC Ter 11",
        "RepublicDay FRENCH Vendemiaire 1",
        "RevolutionDay FRENCH Sansculottides 6",
    ]
    calendars := calendar_names()
    for definition := definitions[]
        fields := definition.split(" ")
        calendar := name_index(calendars, fields[1])
        candidate := math.max(1, year_at(calendar, first))
        while year_start(calendar, candidate) < last
            month := named_month(calendar, candidate, fields[2])
            day := parse_integer(fields[3])
            lengths := month_lengths(calendar, candidate)
            if day <= lengths[month - 1]
                fixed := to_fixed(calendar, Date(candidate, month, day))
                if first <= fixed < last
                    events = events.append(Holiday(fixed, fields[0], calendar))
            candidate += 1
    distinct<int> unique_dates
    for event := events[]
        .unique_dates.add(event.fixed)
    string[] lines := []
    for fixed := unique_dates.sorted()[]
        for event := events[]
            if event.fixed == fixed
                lines = lines.append("{date_format(0, fixed)} {weekday(fixed)} {event.name} {calendars[event.calendar]} {date_format(event.calendar, fixed)}")
    return lines

string[] command(const string[] words)
    verb := words[0]
    arguments := words[1:]
    schema := command_schema(verb)
    if not valid_arguments(verb, arguments, schema)
        return ["INVALID COMMAND"]
    calendar := -1
    int[] fixed_dates := []
    for: 0 <= index < int(#schema)
        if schema[index] == "ANY" or schema[index] == "YEARCAL" or schema[index] == "YMD"
            calendar = name_index(calendar_names(), arguments[index])
        elif schema[index] == "DATE"
            validation := validate_date(calendar, arguments[index])
            if validation.reason != ""
                return [if verb == "VALID" then "NO " + validation.reason elif validation.reason == "RANGE" then "OUT OF RANGE" else "INVALID DATE"]
            fixed_dates = fixed_dates.append(validation.fixed)
    calendar = name_index(calendar_names(), arguments[0])
    fixed := if #fixed_dates > 0 then fixed_dates[0] else 0
    if verb == "CONVERT"
        return [date_format(name_index(calendar_names(), arguments[3]), fixed)]
    if verb == "VALID"
        return ["YES " + date_format(calendar, fixed)]
    if verb == "WEEKDAY"
        return [weekday(fixed)]
    if verb == "ALL"
        string[] result := []
        calendars := calendar_names()
        for: 0 <= index < 12
            text := date_format(index, fixed)
            if text != "OUT OF RANGE" and ymd_calendar(index)
                date := from_fixed(index, fixed)
                names := month_names(index, date.year)
                text += " " + names[date.month - 1]
            result = result.append(calendars[index] + " " + text)
        return result
    if verb == "INFO"
        date := from_fixed(calendar, fixed)
        names := month_names(calendar, date.year)
        day_name := weekday(fixed)
        if calendar == 8
            decade := "Primidi Duodi Tridi Quartidi Quintidi Sextidi Septidi Octidi Nonidi Decadi".split(" ")
            festivals := "Vertu Genie Travail Opinion Recompenses Revolution".split(" ")
            day_name = if date.month == 13 then festivals[date.day - 1] else decade[(date.day - 1) % 10]
        return ["{day_name} {date.day} {names[date.month - 1]} {date.year} day={fixed - year_start(calendar, date.year) + 1}/{year_length(calendar, date.year)}"]
    if verb == "LEAP" or verb == "MONTHS" or verb == "MONTHCAL" or verb == "NTH" or verb == "NEWYEAR"
        year := parse_integer(arguments[1])
        if verb == "LEAP"
            result := (if leap_year(calendar, year) then "YES" else "NO") + " {year_length(calendar, year)}"
            if calendar == 4
                result += " " + hebrew_year_type(year)
            return [result]
        if verb == "NEWYEAR"
            if year > 9999
                return ["OUT OF RANGE"]
            first := year_start(0, year)
            last := year_start(0, year + 1)
            candidate := math.max(1, year_at(calendar, first))
            string[] result := []
            while year_start(calendar, candidate) < last
                start := year_start(calendar, candidate)
                if start >= first
                    result = result.append("{candidate}:{date_format(0, start)}")
                candidate += 1
            return [if #result == 0 then "NONE" else result.join(" ")]
        lengths := month_lengths(calendar, year)
        names := month_names(calendar, year)
        if verb == "MONTHS"
            string[] result := []
            for: 0 <= index < int(#lengths)
                result = result.append("{names[index]}={lengths[index]}")
            return [result.join(" ")]
        month := parse_integer(arguments[2])
        if month < 1 or month > int(#lengths)
            return ["INVALID DATE"]
        first := to_fixed(calendar, Date(year, month, 1))
        last := first + lengths[month - 1] - 1
        if verb == "MONTHCAL"
            if not supported(first) or not supported(last)
                return ["OUT OF RANGE"]
            return month_calendar(calendar, year, month, first, last)
        wanted := name_index(weekday_names(), arguments[4])
        result := if arguments[3] == "LAST" then last - modulo(last - wanted, 7) else first + modulo(wanted - first, 7) + 7 * (parse_integer(arguments[3]) - 1)
        return [if result > last then "NONE" else date_format(calendar, result)]
    if verb == "DIFF"
        return [string(fixed_dates[1] - fixed)]
    if verb == "COUNT"
        first := math.min(fixed, fixed_dates[1])
        last := math.max(fixed, fixed_dates[1])
        wanted := name_index(weekday_names(), arguments[3])
        initial := first + modulo(wanted - first, 7)
        return [string(if initial > last then 0 else (last - initial) / 7 + 1)]
    if verb == "ADD"
        amount := parse_integer(arguments[2])
        unit := arguments[3]
        if unit == "DAYS" or unit == "WEEKS"
            return [date_format(calendar, fixed + amount * (if unit == "DAYS" then 1 else 7))]
        match shift_date(calendar, from_fixed(calendar, fixed), if unit == "YEARS" then amount else 0, if unit == "MONTHS" then amount else 0)
            Date result
                return [date_format(calendar, to_fixed(calendar, result))]
            error problem
                return [problem.message]
    if verb == "SPAN"
        first := math.min(fixed, fixed_dates[1])
        last := math.max(fixed, fixed_dates[1])
        start := from_fixed(calendar, first)
        ending := from_fixed(calendar, last)
        years := ending.year - start.year
        annual := shift_date(calendar, start, years, 0)
        if to_fixed(calendar, annual) > last
            years -= 1
            annual = shift_date(calendar, start, years, 0)
        months := months_before(calendar, ending.year) + ending.month - months_before(calendar, annual.year) - annual.month
        shifted := shift_date(calendar, start, years, months)
        if to_fixed(calendar, shifted) > last
            months -= 1
            shifted = shift_date(calendar, start, years, months)
        days := last - to_fixed(calendar, shifted)
        return [(if fixed > fixed_dates[1] then "-" else "") + "{years}y {months}m {days}d"]
    if verb == "ROUND"
        wanted_number := parse_integer(arguments[2])
        wanted_name := name_index(tzolkin_names(), arguments[3])
        wanted_day := parse_integer(arguments[4])
        wanted_month := name_index(haab_names(), arguments[5])
        for: fixed <= candidate <= fixed + 18979
            count := candidate + 1137142
            haab := modulo(count + 348, 365)
            if modulo(count + 3, 13) + 1 == wanted_number and modulo(count + 19, 20) == wanted_name and haab % 20 == wanted_day and haab / 20 == wanted_month
                return [date_format(calendar, candidate)]
        return ["NONE"]
    year := parse_integer(arguments[0])
    if verb == "MOLAD"
        result := molad_info(year)
        if not supported(result.fixed)
            return ["OUT OF RANGE"]
        rules := if #result.rules == 0 then "NONE" else result.rules.join("+")
        return ["{weekday(result.day_index - 1373427)} {result.parts / 1080}h {result.parts % 1080}p {rules} {weekday(result.fixed)} {date_format(0, result.fixed)}"]
    if year > 9999
        return ["OUT OF RANGE"]
    if verb == "HOLIDAYS"
        return holiday_lines(year)
    if verb == "PASSOVER"
        month := named_month(4, year + 3760, "Nisan")
        result := to_fixed(4, Date(year + 3760, month, 15))
        return [date_format(0, result) + " " + weekday(result)]
    kind := if arguments[1] == "GREGORIAN" then 0 else 1
    result := easter_info(year, kind)
    if verb == "EASTER"
        return [date_format(0, result.easter)]
    return ["golden={result.golden} epact={result.epact} letters={result.letters} moon={date_format(kind, result.moon)} easter={date_format(kind, result.easter)}"]
